prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Eterno Retorno. Original post-apocalyptic civilian resistance world. AMERICAN ACTION COMIC, late 1990s arcade fighting-game illustration. Bold confident BLACK INK contours, clean angular silhouettes, rich FLAT vibrant colors, large HARD-EDGED cel-shaded shadows, bold printed halftone. Deep ink black and aubergine, vivid teal/cyan electronics, rusty orange and violet clothing, warm natural skin. NOT pencil sketchbook, NOT grayscale, NO dense scratchy crosshatching, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO pixel art. Ordinary people with patched civilian clothes and improvised tools fight autonomous machines. NO medieval armor, swords, cloaks, runes, magic staffs, skeletons, goblins or monsters. No franchise characters, logos or superhero costumes. No text or UI baked in unless explicitly required. Protagonist design MUST match the reference exactly: Vera,27,young woman with silver-gray short tousled bob, teacher, graphite-smudged fingers, pencil behind ear. Aubergine civilian long coat with teal lining over cream ordinary shirt and worn gray trousers, scuffed boots, notebook and reused school satchel. Holds a homemade electromagnetic pulse device built from an old antenna, exposed cables and a salvaged battery, with small cyan arcs; NO magic staff, NO robes, NO plate armor. Curious determined civilian, not military. ONE frozen COMIC foreground closeup, ferociously attacking toward RIGHT. Fierce furious expression, brows down, teeth clenched or battle cry. Face, torso, arms and improvised tool large and clear. Thin white silhouette outline around body AND weapon. Landscape1536x1024, clear margins, TRUE transparent background. No sprite sheet, no multiple poses. Colored lights and sparks limited to a few isolated marks; game animates effects behind.
NEW FINAL ART DIRECTION: original printed American action COMIC BOOK, this is a full REDRAW of the illustration. Strong expressive black ink outlines, angular purposeful shapes, two-tone cel shadows, vivid controlled hero accents on a dark violet/steel/petrol palette, visible Ben-Day halftone clusters and occasional dry ink. A clear THIN WHITE PAPER CUTOUT border around every person, machine, standalone object and icon silhouette. Comics cut-paper aesthetic, NOT 3D, NOT realistic painting, NOT pixel art, NOT generic airbrushed fantasy. Civilian survivors versus autonomous killing machines; retain their identities, jobs, workwear and improvised tools. No superhero costumes. The illustration must visibly feel like hand-inked printed comic art. True transparent alpha behind the entire cutout and ALL gutters; no solid rectangular backdrops, no opaque panels. White silhouette contour, selective speed hatching and small isolated comic spark accents only, all within canvas.
